input: Dye and re-grout the bathroom vanity countertop

gold.taskTitle: Dye and Re-grout the Bathroom Vanity Countertop
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to dye and re-grout their bathroom vanity countertop as a DIY or managed renovation task.

questions.title: What material is the countertop made of?
questions.description: Knowing whether it is tile, cultured marble, granite, laminate, or another material determines which dye products and grout types are compatible.

questions.title: What color is the countertop being dyed to?
questions.description: The target color affects product selection, number of coats needed, and whether a primer or bonding agent is required.

questions.title: What is the current condition of the existing grout?
questions.description: Understanding whether the grout is cracked, crumbling, stained, or simply discolored determines how much removal work is needed before re-grouting.

questions.title: What color grout do you want to use?
questions.description: The desired grout color guides product purchasing and whether a grout colorant or full grout replacement is the better approach.

questions.title: Is this a DIY project or will you hire a professional?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan should focus on sourcing tools and materials personally or on finding and vetting contractors.

questions.title: What is your target completion date or deadline?
questions.description: A timeline helps prioritize steps, account for drying and curing periods, and schedule any supply purchases or contractor visits.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for this project?
questions.description: The budget determines whether to use professional-grade products, rental tools, or cost-effective DIY alternatives.
